title: Frontend: Journal tab — list entries, create entry with mood picker
description: Build the Journal tab showing all journal entries in reverse-chronological order with a prominent 'Log Update' button to create new entries.
acceptanceCriteria: Each entry shows: title, mood emoji, body preview (first 150 chars), date
Click entry to expand full content
'Log Update' button opens entry creation form
Pagination or infinite scroll for entries
Edit and delete actions on each entry

steps.details: Create src/components/project/tabs/JournalTab.tsx. Fetch entries with useInfiniteQuery (paginated). 'Log Update' button fixed/prominent. Map entries to JournalEntryCard.
Card showing title, mood emoji (excited=🚀, blocked=🚧, steady=⚡, win=🏆, learning=📚), date, body truncated to 150 chars. Click to expand full Tiptap render. Edit/delete actions in dropdown.
Edit: open the create/edit dialog prefilled. Delete: shadcn/ui AlertDialog confirmation → DELETE API call → invalidate query.
Create 3 journal entries. Verify listed newest first. Expand one — verify full content visible. Delete one — verify removed.
